data.enemies.mechanic.telarana.name: Web
data.enemies.mechanic.telarana.counter: Every 3 actions it traps a player, who loses their next turn. An ally frees them by using Attack on them (the menu shows "Free"; costs half a turn). Solo: you struggle and lose half a turn.
data.enemies.mechanic.escarcha.name: Frozen Field
data.enemies.mechanic.escarcha.counter: While its Ice Crystals live, each Serpent turn the party loses 10% speed (max −50%). Break the crystals (or break the Serpent: a break shatters one) to thaw the field. Glacial Breath forms them again. Solo: 1 crystal.
data.enemies.mechanic.postura.name: Stance
data.enemies.mechanic.postura.counter: Shield: −70% physical damage (attacks and physical skills). Sword: −70% magic damage. Switches every 2 of its turns (warns 1 turn ahead). Hit it with what it does not block; broken, it loses its stance. Solo: −50%.
data.enemies.mechanic.ecos.name: Echoes
data.enemies.mechanic.ecos.counter: The Sorceress Echoes attack and take only 50% damage: they have little life and fall in a few hits. The real one takes full damage: focus your hits on her. Breaking her dispels an echo; after 3 turns with echoes down she creates them again, and Choir of Echoes hits harder for each living echo. Solo: 1 echo.
data.enemies.mechanic.lava.name: Lava Pools
data.enemies.mechanic.lava.counter: Every 3 actions the Beast raises the lava for 2 of its turns. With lava up, whoever is Defending at the start of their turn gets burned (ATK × 0.4, Defend does not reduce it) and gains +2 Burn. Do not defend on lava: attack or heal. Solo: ATK × 0.25 and +1 Burn.
data.enemies.mechanic.sequito.name: Retinue
data.enemies.mechanic.sequito.counter: While any Spectral Thrall lives, the Specter is immune to statuses (Burn, Poison, Freeze and Stun do not land). Kill the thralls first; after 3 turns with the retinue incomplete it summons them again, and Eternal Lament fills it. Solo: 1 thrall.
data.enemies.mechanic.marca.name: Void Mark
data.enemies.mechanic.marca.counter: Every 3 actions the Sentinel marks a player: its next hit goes to them and deals ×2. Have another ally Protect them (Protection or Bulwark) to take it normally. Solo: Defend also counters it.
data.enemies.mechanic.fases.name: End of Time
data.enemies.mechanic.fases.counter: Final boss in 2 phases. At 50% life it transforms: it loses its statuses and break bar, hits +15% and casts Time Collapse every 2 actions (all targets, delays). Save heals and defenses for phase 2; End of the Eras wipes buffs.
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_reloj.name: Abyss Clock
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_reloj.count: 3 phases. Rewind: heals what it took since its last action; break it first (it warns). Distortion: delays the party. Phase 2: Deluge soaks and Discharge shocks the Wet: Defend so it does not react. Solo: rewinds 50% and delays less.
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_eco.name: Abyss Echoes
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_eco.counter: Its Echoes copy the party''s last skill (element included) and take 50%. Seal: takes 25% until broken by the reaction it asks for (or a break). Solo: 1 echo and any reaction breaks the seal.
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_corona.name: Abyss Crown
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_corona.coun: The party''s heals hurt it (60%, potions too). With thralls alive it is immune to statuses and, in phase 2, immune to damage: kill the thralls or heal. Solo: 1 thrall.
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_eras.name: Abyss Hunger
data.enemies.mechanic.abismo_eras.counte: 3 phases. Devour: eats the party''s buffs and shields and gains +5% ATK for each: do not stack them before the warning. Phase 3: changes aspect every turn (Fire, Water, Electro, Ice) and resists its own element.
Every element: cycling aspect, seals, copying echoes, devour, rewind and distortion. Heals hurt it (40%). Phase 3: immune to damage while echoes live. Solo: 1 echo, any reaction breaks the seal.
